name: Scroll Disintegrate
description: A centered image that breaks into many randomly scattered pixel fragments as the page scrolls, fragments rotating, drifting and fading out like a Thanos-style dissolve.
contents: Fixed centered image captured into canvas fragments
Scroll spacer that provides the scroll range
behavior: Image is rasterized with html2canvas and split into particleCount random pixel layers
Each layer rotates, drifts and fades out, scrubbed to scroll with staggered delays
Original image is hidden once fragments are created and restored on unmount
editableByProps: Fragment count, overlap, rotation and displacement

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the scroll range over which the fragments animate

fixed: Image and fragments are position fixed at viewport center, so the effect is tied to the viewport while the component is mounted
Spacer height (scrollDistance) is needed for the scroll range
Image must be CORS-enabled for html2canvas capture
Fragment generation is pixel-based and can be heavy on very large images
